primary.predictor: water_depth_z, standardized across the 282 joined days
primary.seasonal_control: year fixed effects + cubic B-spline of within-year season_progress with df=4
primary.season_progress: (date - first joined date in that year)/(last joined date - first joined date in that year)
primary.covariance: Block Newey-West HAC with Bartlett weights and maxlags=7, summing autocovariance terms only within calendar year so year boundaries are never treated as adjacent days.

sensitivities.year_specific_season_curve: Replace common spline by year fixed effects plus year-specific linear and quadratic season_progress terms; same water-depth predictor and HAC(7).
sensitivities.within_year_depth_z: Standardize water depth within year before fitting the primary seasonal model.
sensitivities.consecutive_day_first_difference: For joined dates exactly one calendar day apart within the same year, regress delta log1p(calling) on delta water depth with year fixed effects; block HAC maxlags=3. Positive coefficient is directional support, with no pass gate.
sensitivities.leave_one_year_out: Refit primary model five times omitting one year; report signs and CIs without requiring all individual CIs to exclude zero.

no_binary_water_test: No water-depth >0 versus <=0 test is authorized because the 282 joined calling-season dates contain zero water-depth days = 0.

interpretation.if_supported: Independent single-site evidence that direct breeding-wetland water state covaries positively with calling activity beyond broad annual and seasonal progression.
interpretation.if_not_supported: The NAAMP soil-water association remains internally strong but does not receive support from this direct-water-depth case study.
boundaries: Single species and single wetland; not a replication of NAAMP community matrix geometry.
Calling data span each year's first-to-last calling interval and are not year-round monitoring zeros.
Temperature, precipitation and other daily covariates are not included in this frozen test; residual confounding remains.
Water depth is habitat hydrology, not frog body hydration.
Observational association does not establish causal mediation.
No RC11 submission change is authorized.
